purpose: Short T15 two-room integrated synthetic media, receiver recovery, and revoked-publisher resume smoke.

tls.trust: local CA imported only into isolated Firefox NSS profiles; certificate errors are not ignored

roles.studio-publisher: studio participant granted publishing by the studio host UI

topology.network: one externally running managed local HTTPS/WSS application

credentials.hostToken: provided in process memory; value not recorded
credentials.roomPassword: provided in process memory; value not recorded
credentials.resumeTokens: observed only as presence flags; values not retained

syntheticSources.audio: per-room oscillator routed through AudioContext MediaStreamDestination; no physical microphone
syntheticSources.video: per-room animated canvas returned by test-only getDisplayMedia replacement; no physical display capture

disturbance.kind: test-only Playwright WebSocketRoute close on the studio host receiver connection
disturbance.claim: controlled application connection close only; not a Cloud Run timeout, TCP shaping, packet loss, or real background transition

limits.streamSeparation: room/source clock IDs, stream configuration and synthetic decoded pixel colors are checked; no raw media hash audit is performed
limits.disturbance: route close simulates a local application connection drop; it is not a real weak network or server timeout
limits.devices: no phone, physical microphone, physical display, human listening, real backgrounding, packet loss, p95, capacity, durability, or Cloud Run result
limits.productStatus: this short feasibility smoke does not establish full POC-04 completion or deployment readiness
